title: Nigeria's Naccima Courts Chinese Investors to Drive $1 Trillion Economy Push
detail: Nigeria's Chamber of Commerce, Industry, Mines and Agriculture (Naccima) is actively courting Chinese investors as part of the country's broader push toward a $1 trillion economy target. The initiative focuses on boosting industrialization through foreign direct investment, with Chinese firms seen as key partners in manufacturing, infrastructure, and technology sectors. The outreach reflects Abuja's pivot toward deepening South-South economic ties as it seeks to diversify beyond oil revenues.

media.caption: Naccima courts Chinese investors to boost Nigeria's industrialization drive
